A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-itcanwait-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[It Can Wait (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 24 January 2018): Same words as the disc card. This is a full card image, 350 × 490 pixels, with the white italic “E” in the black lower border in place of the bronze disc.

The whole of the disc card and the whole of the 2018 E card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
